snippet.title: The Hood: The World is His | Character Reveal Trailer | Marvel Rivals
snippet.description:
From the shadows of the New York underground comes the newest power-hungry villain. 🔥
 
Cloaked in a cursed mantle, Parker Robbins lost his faith in heroes alongside his father and his world's Captain America - replacing it with an insatiable appetite for the power to change the world. Stealing an enchanted cloak from the Vault, he remade himself as the feared crime lord, The Hood.
 
Now, The Hood treads a perilous path through channeling dark magic, devouring enemy firepower, and transforming into a demonic abomination of cosmic magic and steel. Even after a deadly clash in Thebes with Gambit and Doom 2099 over the Tablet of Death and Entropy, his dark journey is far from over...
 
📅 Season 9.5 arrives on August 7th, 2026 UTC!
 
Dare to dream... 🕯️

snippet.title: Violent Night 2 | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Merry Christmas to all, and to all a good fight. Violent Night 2 only in theaters December 4.

If you’re nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you’re naughty, you get justice. 

David Harbour reprises his role as Santa Claus in a propulsive new chapter in yuletide mayhem from 87North—the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde and the Nobody franchise—and returning action director Tommy Wirkola. 

In 2022’s bare-knuckle holiday sensation, Violent Night, an embittered Santa, armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Jared Harris) terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall. 

But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell).  

Along with David Harbour, Jared Harris and Kristen Bell, the dynamic cast includes Emmy winning screen legend Joe Pantoliano (The Last of Us, The Sopranos), Daniela Melchior (Fast X, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3), Andrew Bachelor (Greenland, The Walking Dead), and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman (The Iron Claw, Happy Gilmore 2). 

Violent Night 2 is directed by returning filmmaker Tommy Wirkola and produced again by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch. The film’s returning screenwriters are Pat Casey and Josh Miller. Violent Night 2 will be released by Universal Pictures.

snippet.title: The Search For The Leviathan
snippet.description:
In the last few months, hundreds of reports have appeared all over the internet, all claiming to see the same thing in their Minecraft oceans - a sea monster called The Leviathan. But is it just a massive hoax, or is there something more to it? I'm going to find out.

Voice of Hummer:  @schpoody 
Voice of Arronax:  @jumperwho 

ORIGINAL MUSIC BY: Ben Bracey (@benbraceymusic on instagram)
https://soundcloud.com/benbraceymusic/sets/hunting-the-leviathan-original

Download all the builds in this video for $5 on both Java and Bedrock!!: https://maps.wifies.net/products/the-leviathan  



DO NOT READ BELOW FOR SPOILERS:


Well well well here we are again. I think this video is interesting in that the first 12 minutes can't prepare you for the remaining hour; as in the pacing is very different/the style totally shifts. So we'll see how that goes...

I'm really fond of the ending I like how that last 10 minutes turned out. That final scene with hummer was inspired by one of my favorite short stories, "Hell is the Absence of God" by Ted Chiang. There are definitely some parts of the video that I think could be a little better like maybe the dialogue is a bit dragged but overall I'm pretty satisfied with the majority of the video. 

Thematically, I think you might be able to tell the kind of story I was playing around with, but I was also hugely inspired by the Lochness Monster. Probably some of my favorite parts of research for this video was reading the Lochness Monster wiki and learning more about the kind of theories/tools people use to look for it. The F3 scene on hummer's boat was inspired by all the sonar and stuff people use to check for Nessie.

Also just a MASSIVE shoutout to schpood for all the hours and care he poured into this video. I'm so thankful for the enthusiasm and feedback he gave and the video would be so much worse without him. And thank you to my discord server members for making (almost) all of the fake reports you see in this video. They were super creative and did a way better job than I could have. 


➤➤ Twitter: https://twitter.com/wifiestwt
➤➤ Discord: https://discord.gg/zAWUuWb


➤➤Links: 

Want to listen to or license the music I use? Check it out here: https://www.epidemicsound.com/community/playlist/?_us=Affiliate&_usx=1xis5q&utm_source=1xis5q&utm_medium=organicambassador&utm_campaign=1xis5q&playlist=uad3vzakh605efvoqoi24llhnpr9lm2y

LEMMiNO - Blackout
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RsVVcsVDt-s
CC BY-SA 4.0

Water Lantern designed by: @MythicalPingu 

Submarine tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ud22yz0p7s


All screenshots/reddit posts/websites in this video do NOT exist and were made for the sake of the video. If any link redirects to an actual website - that is coincidental and do not treat it as "official";  it was just put in the video make the world feel more real. 

This is NOT series called Minecraft VVSauce where I explore random features of Minecraft. Not Secret Minecraft things or Minecraft lore (like Game Theory) or Escape Rooms, but an ARG that isn't an ARG but it's actually unfiction - a genre pretending to be real that isn't real but we all pretend to be real. This is the search for the leviathan. I hope you enjoy

Aegon The Conqueror and Valyria Explained. Daemon Targaryen and Vermithor Explained. Dance of The Dragons Trailer and A Song of Ice And Fire Book Easter Eggs. snippet.title: Teenage Dirtbag by Wheatus - A Bardcore | Medieval Cover by Hildegard von Blingin' ft. Friar Funk
snippet.description:
▶ This song will be out mid-August, but you can listen to my other work on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/5BSPl6yCVGvrCyKUp2peGM?si=yyY9lJHsTwq-vf4y2nv9DQ
▶ Consider supporting the channel on Patreon, where I share all my instrumentals: https://patreon.com/hildegardvonblingin

I'm thrilled to welcome my brother Friar Funk back for a feature in this cover of the Wheatus angst anthem "Teenage Dirtbag". We had a lot of fun recording in between bellowing Mordhau and Elder Scrolls lines at each other. Oh, and before anyone gets all clever in the comments, yes the iron maiden (ye old spiked sarcophagus) is mostly a myth, but you'll have to forgive the anachronism because how could I not keep that in?

As always, this music is human made. I wrote the lyrics, created the instrumental from a mix of real and sampled instruments, and we recorded the vocals in my little turret studio.

I'll provide a few notes about the language, because there are some fun words in this one.
Greenhorn: an inexperienced person/newcomer who lacks skill and knowledge.
Wagtail: An obsequious, timid person who fawns and bows like e nervous bird.
Hedgeborn: A person born of low, mean, or unknown birth. Perhaps even on the side of the road somewhere.
Blaggard: A scoundrel, a rogue, or a rascal.

The Art: I illustrated this one from scratch but looked at lots of sad peasants in manuscripts during the process. 

The Lyrics:
Her name is Noelle
I have a dream about her
Under some spell
I’ve Vespers within the hour
How she is fair
With flowers in her hair
But she knoweth not that I live
And she giveth not a fig about me

For I’m but a greenhorn wagtail, lady
Naught but a hedgeborn blaggard, lady
I'd stand in an iron maiden, lady for thee, oh

Her lord is uncouth
He bringeth a sword to Mass
Knew he but the truth
My hide he would surely thrash
His keep's on the hill
'Tis his fields I till
But he knoweth not that I live
And he giveth not a fig about me

For I’m but a greenhorn wagtail, lady
Naught but a hedgeborn blaggard, lady
I'd stand in an iron maiden, lady for thee, oh

Oh, greenhorn!
She knoweth not what she is missing
Oh, hedgeborn!
She knoweth not what she is missing

I feel overbold
This banquet is far too lofty
Lo and behold
She walketh over to me
Must be some ruse, I'll end in the noose
How doth she know that I live?
And why doth she care a whit about me?

I've two palfreys to flee to fair Arcady
Come with me three days hence, I pray thee
I'm naught but a greenhorn wagtail, truly like thee, oh

Oh, greenhorn!
She knoweth not what she is missing
Oh, hedgeborn!
She knoweth not what she is missing

A peaceful summer day turns into a nightmare when hundreds of strange baby sea creatures suddenly crawl onto a crowded beach, attacking anything in their path. As panic spreads and mysterious disappearances increase, authorities struggle to understand the source of the horrifying outbreak.

snippet.title: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 is officially here to close out the chapter. See how Genno prepares for his final attack on the island.

This update marks the end of the current era, with major changes arriving for the finale. We examine the current state of the map and how Genno's deception as the visitor finally comes to a head. If you are looking for a breakdown of the lore implications and what to expect as the season wraps up, this covers everything you need to know about the current plot progression.

Everything hinges on the device used to stabilize the Zero Point. We analyze what this means for the upcoming conflict and how the setup for the next phase of the game is being positioned. Understanding these story beats helps clarify why the stakes are higher than ever for the Fortnite finale.

Subscribe for weekly Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 lore breakdowns, and comment which theory you have about the Zero Point device.

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: Big Walk is out now!
snippet.description:
Big Walk is OUT NOW on Steam, Switch 2, & PlayStation 5! Hooray!

Join House House for a brief celebration of the game's launch.

Hang out and get lost with close friends in a big world. A cooperative online walker-talker from the creators of Untitled Goose Game.

Set out with your friends through a wide-open world full of challenges, puzzles, and discoveries. You’ll need to work together to find your way around, stay in contact using an assortment of tools and toys, and figure out new ways to communicate when you suddenly find yourself speechless.

Adventuring aside, there’s plenty of time to just hang out. Sit and watch the sunset, or steal your friend’s binoculars and kick them into the ocean. Spending time with friends is the best part of a big walk.

Big Walk was developed by House House and published by Panic.

On this channel, you’ll find long-form video essays about gaming’s biggest stories from studio collapses and corporate greed to the creative risks that still push the medium forward. I break down industry trends, publisher decisions, and the economics behind how games are made, marketed, and sold.

snippet.title: Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor Gameplay First Look | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Salieri’s not here to play games.

Get your first look at the new gameplay features and items coming to Mafia: The Old Country when the Man of Honor expansion releases on August 14, 2026.

► Learn more and wishlist now: https://2kgam.es/ManOfHonor

Sicily – Winter, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his.

At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the volatile underworld of the Valle Dorata, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

Continue Enzo's story across two new chapters, featuring fresh environments, weapons, vehicles, and Charms. In new DLC content for Free Ride mode, team up with Salieri to earn big by taking on a new set of exclusive jobs and extreme challenges, and discover new collectibles and hidden locations as you explore. 

#ps5 #ps5games #MafiaGame #MafiaTheOldCountry

Rated Mature

This will be the 112th British Chess Championship, part of a prestigious series that has run almost uninterrupted since 1904.

We are raising money in memory of Adam Hunt and Jonathan Hawkins, two much-loved members of our chess community who we lost to cancer last year, and in support of the many others in our community who continue to be affected by this devastating illness. ABOUT THE THING THAT HAPPENED:
In a post-apocalyptic world, Marcus Draven who arrived in the city of Jericho. The city was in ruins, with remnants of an old civilization scattered everywhere. Marcus had been traveling for days, scavenging for food and supplies to survive in this harsh new world.
As Marcus entered Jericho, he was met with a desolate landscape - crumbling buildings, overgrown vegetation, and a sense of eerie silence. The once bustling city was now a ghost town, haunted by the memories of its former glory.
Though the world around them remained harsh and unforgiving, the spirit of resilience and community in Jericho served as a beacon of hope in the face of adversity. Marcus journey in the post-apocalyptic city of Jericho was a testament to the human capacity for survival, adaptation, and the enduring will to rebuild even in the bleakest of circumstances.

snippet.description:

Golden Gnomes nominations are open: https://survey.alchemer.eu/s3/91157074/2026-Golden-Gnome-Award-Nomination-Form If you want to vote for me the best categories are best osrs video (chunk inferno completion) and best series (xtreme onechunk ironman)

The starting chunk on this account is the Kourend Castle chunk in Zeah. We are following Limpwurt's Xtreme Onechunk ironman rules to take on this challenge. Before I can roll and continue to another gamechunk I have to complete:
1. All of the highest level skilling challenges (including skillcapes)
2. Do all available achievement diary tasks and quests
3. Obtain all unique monster drops
4. Obtain all unique items in a chunk
5. Get all unique minigame rewards

Socials:
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/verf
Kick: https://kick.com/verf
Discord: https://discord.gg/buUrDj3sfJ

Chunk map: https://source-chunk.github.io/chunk-picker-v2/?verf
